name: Field Museum
unique: A natural history museum with SUE the T. rex, ancient Egyptian tombs, a man eating lion exhibit and a vast Native American collection.
buzz: The dinosaur and the Egypt gallery are the priorities, and the building itself is grand. Allow half a day.

name: Shedd Aquarium
unique: A 1930 aquarium on the lake with a Caribbean reef, belugas, otters and a Amazon flooded forest, plus a aquatic show.
buzz: The beluga and otter habitats are the favorites, and the building is beautiful. Book tickets ahead.

name: Museum of Science and Industry
unique: A huge science museum with a real U-boat, a coal mine, a 727 and a giant model train layout, in the 1893 World's Fair building.
buzz: The U-boat tour is the standout and the coal mine is a close second. Plan for half a day.

name: Lincoln Park Zoo
unique: A free zoo in the middle of the city with lions, apes, penguins and a farm, open every day of the year.
buzz: Free and genuinely good, which is rare for a city zoo. The penguin house is the kid favorite.

name: Millennium Park
unique: A downtown park with Cloud Gate, the Pritzker Pavilion, a fountain and a garden, on the old rail yards.
buzz: The Bean is the photo and the park is a good walk. Free and central.

name: Chicago Riverwalk
unique: A 1.25 mile promenade along the Chicago River with bars, kayak rentals, architecture tours and the bridges overhead.
buzz: The river level view of the architecture is the reason, and the bars are a good stop. Best at sunset.

name: Wrigley Field
unique: The second oldest ballpark in the majors, with the ivy covered walls, the manual scoreboard and the rooftop seats across the street.
buzz: The tour gets you into the dugout and the press box, and the history is the draw. Book ahead.

name: Pullman National Historical Park
unique: A planned industrial town built by the Pullman company, with the factory, the row houses and the story of the 1894 strike.
buzz: The architecture and the labor history together are the point. Free, with a visitor center.

name: Frank Lloyd Wright Home and Studio
unique: Wright's own home and studio, where he developed the Prairie style, with guided tours and a neighborhood full of his houses.
buzz: The studio tour is the best architecture hour in the Chicago area. Book ahead and walk the neighborhood after.

name: Galena Historic District
unique: A river town of brick storefronts, steep streets and 19th century houses, once a lead mining boomtown and now a weekend getaway.
buzz: The main street is polished and the houses are beautiful. Busy in fall.

name: The Children's Museum of Indianapolis
unique: The largest children's museum in the world, with a dinosaur hall, a carousel, a space station and a working water clock.
buzz: Overwhelming in a good way, with enough for a full day. The dinosaur exhibit is the star.

name: Indianapolis Motor Speedway Museum
unique: A museum of the 500 with winning cars, trophies and the bricks, plus a track tour on the speedway.
buzz: The winning cars and the track tour are the reasons. Book the tour with the museum.

name: Newfields
unique: An art museum and 152 acre campus with gardens, a lake, a greenhouse and a sculpture park.
buzz: The gardens and the art are both strong, and the campus is a good walk. Free on some days.

name: Conner Prairie
unique: A living history park with an 1836 village, a Lenape camp, a working farm and a balloon ride.
buzz: The interpreters are good and kids can try chores and crafts. Allow half a day.

name: Brown County State Park
unique: The largest state park in Indiana, with ridge trails, a fire tower, a lodge and some of the best fall color in the Midwest.
buzz: The fire tower view is the payoff and the trails are rolling. October is packed.

name: Indiana State Fair
unique: A big state fair with livestock shows, a midway, tractor pulls, fried food and the dairy bar.
buzz: The dairy bar and the livestock barns are the local picks. Go on a weekday.

name: University of Notre Dame
unique: A campus with the Golden Dome, the basilica, the grotto and the football stadium, all walkable around two lakes.
buzz: The basilica and the grotto are the quiet highlights, and game weekends are a scene. Free to walk.

name: French Lick Springs
unique: A historic mineral spring resort with a grand hotel, a casino, a spa and the Pluto mineral water that made it famous.
buzz: The hotel is a step back in time and the grounds are pretty. Worth a walk even if you are not staying.

name: Parke County Covered Bridge Festival
unique: A county with 31 covered bridges and a festival that fills them with craft fairs, food and traffic.
buzz: Pick a few bridges and drive the back roads, and go early to beat the crowds. The festival is the busiest week.

name: Cincinnati Museum Center
unique: Three museums in the Art Deco Union Terminal: natural history, Cincinnati history and a children's museum.
buzz: The building is worth the trip alone, and the history museum has a great model of the city.

name: Cincinnati Zoo
unique: The second oldest zoo in the country, with hippos, gorillas, a train and the Fiona the hippo story.
buzz: Well laid out and shady, with the hippo exhibit as the draw. Allow half a day.

name: Columbus Zoo and Aquarium
unique: A zoo and aquarium with polar bears, manatees, a water park and a golf course, on the Scioto River.
buzz: The manatee rescue and the polar bears are the highlights, and the water park makes it a full day.

name: Franklin Park Conservatory
unique: A glasshouse with biomes from rainforest to desert, plus a butterfly garden and a collection of Chihuly glass.
buzz: The Chihuly glass among the plants is the draw, and the butterfly house is a kid favorite.

name: Cleveland Museum of Art
unique: A free encyclopedic museum with Asian art, medieval armor, Impressionism and a sculpture garden.
buzz: Free and world class, with a beautiful building and a good cafe. One of the best museums in the country.

name: West Side Market
unique: A 1912 market hall with a vaulted ceiling, butcher stalls, pierogi stands and produce vendors under one roof.
buzz: The building is beautiful and the food is cheap. Go hungry and bring cash.

name: Great Lakes Science Center
unique: A science center on the lake with a NASA Glenn visitor center, a domed theater and hands on exhibits.
buzz: The NASA exhibits are the draw and the lakefront location is nice. Good for kids.

name: Toledo Museum of Art
unique: A free art museum with a strong glass collection, Old Masters and a sculpture garden, in a Greek Revival building.
buzz: The glass collection is the local specialty and the museum is free. A surprise for a mid sized city.
